sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Chapelim is a earth-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Agility (C), Defense (B).

sections.title: Is the Chapelim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Defense (B). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
